Karnataka forms SIT to reinvestigate Sowjanya rape and murder case

The Karnataka government has formed a Special Investigation Team (SIT) to reinvestigate the rape and murder case of Sowjanya. The case involves concerns about delays in reporting rape cases and low conviction rates in the state, with molestation being the highest category of crime against women in Karnataka.
